title: OKR Weave Workbench and Interteam Dependency Runbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational 'Weave Workbench' and accompanying runbook to (1) surface gaps between company-level OKRs and active initiatives across product, eng, design and GTM; (2) standardize a weekly synchronization flow for routing decisions and escalations; and (3) ship lightweight tooling (scorecard + dependency map) that program managers can use to prioritize cross-team commits. The deliverable is a documented process, a reusable Confluence template, a dependency matrix CSV export, and a small dashboard for visualizing initiative health against OKR signal metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence Weave Workbench template published with instructions
Dependency matrix CSV generated from initial 5 initiative owners
Weekly sync agenda and escalation SLA documented (RACI mapped)
Dashboard shows OKR-to-initiative linkage and at-a-glance health for all company OKRs
Runbook includes triage flow for schedule conflicts and resource contention
